notes: Question templates for verifying a step from an accessibility diff. Every answer is a typed value (bool or a closed enum), never free text: the element spec lives in the question, so nothing about the screen can come back as an instruction (the quarantined-perception pattern in docs/computer-use.md 4.1). The state is the diff only, which is what keeps this inside the 1024-token window. Gold answers are derived from the two trees for scoring; verify_step never returns them.
state_hint: A bounded accessibility diff: lines that appeared, prefixed '+', and lines that disappeared, prefixed '-'. Each line is '<role>: <label>'.

present.instructions: This diff is what changed on screen between two captures. Answer about the CURRENT screen only. Is there now an element with role {role} whose label is "{label}"?

role_present.instructions: This diff is what changed on screen between two captures. Answer about the CURRENT screen only. Does the current screen contain an element with the role {role}?

error_present.instructions: This diff is what changed on screen between two captures. Answer about the CURRENT screen only. Does the current screen contain an element whose label reports an error, a failure or a warning?

net_added.instructions: Count only the lines of this diff. Did more elements appear than disappear?

criteria.appeared_more: more lines start with + than with -
criteria.removed_more: more lines start with - than with +
criteria.equal: the same number of lines start with + and with -
